_comment: Ratchet for `homelab mutants`: undetected (survived + untested) mutants per file. Counts may be lowered or removed, never added or raised by hand. Regenerate with `homelab mutants --update-baseline` after an improvement. Scope lives in [tool.mutmut].only_mutate in pyproject.toml.
_measured: Serial figures (--max-children 1), which is the default and the only mode --update-baseline accepts. All six were reproduced exactly on two independent fresh serial sweeps, so this baseline is exact and carries no drift tolerance -- measure a file twice before ratcheting it. A parallel sweep will report LOWER numbers: that is cross-child interference, not an improvement, and the gate calls it 'improved' rather than failing. Do not ratchet those in.
_history: Two artifacts inflated every figure recorded before 4f1048b, and both credited an environmental failure as a detection. (1) mutmut's per-mutant CPU cap raises SIGXCPU and scores the timeout as killed; fixed in 1839313 by [tool.mutmut].timeout_multiplier. (2) Concurrent children share one mutants/ tree, so a mutant writing under it fails an unrelated child's test; fixed in 4f1048b by defaulting to serial. The baseline shipped in 1839313 still carried artifact 2. Do not compare against any figure older than 4f1048b.
